# Power Share FlexCo

> A consumer-first platform for energy communities, flexibility, and behind-the-meter optimization.

Power Share FlexCo builds the infrastructure that turns every household into an active participant in the energy transition — visible, connected, and fairly compensated.

## What We Do

PowerShareHome is a decentralized home energy management and community platform. It enables households to:

- **See** real-time solar production, battery status, and energy consumption on a live dashboard
- **Share** surplus renewable energy with neighbors through energy communities (Energiegemeinschaften)
- **Earn** fair compensation for flexibility services and shared energy

## Key Capabilities

- Real-time energy monitoring and analytics
- Energy community management and peer comparison
- Utility-grade flexibility dispatch (95%+ forecast accuracy)
- Multi-asset portfolio management (battery storage, heat pumps, EVs, smart plugs)
- Behind-the-meter optimization

## Supported Devices & Protocols

- Inverters (Fronius Solar API, Modbus TCP / SunSpec)
- Battery storage systems
- EV wallboxes (OCPP)
- Smart plugs and appliances (Zigbee)
